**Question**
What do you want to know? Please check the README, CONTRIBUTING.md and existing issues first.

**Context**
What are you trying to achieve? E.g. "I want to run Mecena locally with my own Anthropic key" or "I want to connect Claude Desktop to my Mecena account".
Tell us whether this is about the live app (https://mecena.fly.dev) or a local copy.
